use_case_summary: Product team building an in-app AI assistant + search/rerank pipeline for EU customers. Plan to start on Redwood Hosted API for POC and then migrate to Dedicated reserved capacity (VPC peering) for production to meet residency and throughput SLAs. Needs embeddings for semantic search, low-latency chat responses, and reranking of real-time results.
notes: Intro call 2024-10-15 with VP Product (Hannah Müller) — evaluating LLM features for embedded assistants across EU customer base.
Primary ask: start with Hosted API for dev/test then move to Dedicated within 3-6 months for production with reserved GPUs and VPC peering in eu-west-1.
Latency target: p95 < 150ms for short-chat (<=256 tokens). Throughput target for reranking: ~200 req/s during peak; cost sensitivity on per-token pricing for high volume embeddings/rerank.
Data residency is critical: legal requires inference logs and embeddings to remain in EU region; asking for written residency clause and export controls.
Multi-region routing discussion: prefer EU primary with automated failover to NA only if EU capacity exhausted. Concerned about GDPR cross-border transfers and need for documented fallbacks.
Quote from Hannah: 'We need firm guarantees on where tokens and KV cache live — no indirect transfer to US.'
POC plan agreed: 2-week Hosted POC using eu endpoints (dev environment), then 4-week Dedicated POC with 2-node reserved pool and sample traffic from EU production replicas.
Technical concerns logged: KV cache replication across AZs, cold-start latency for idle models, and whether model-variant fallback will cause cross-region egress.
Pricing questions: committed capacity vs. burst billing math, how network egress is calculated for cross-region failover, and discount thresholds for multi-regional reserved pools.
Security asks: SAML SSO + SCIM, KMS integration (customer-managed keys), SOC2 evidence, audit log retention policy (asking 7 years for select logs), and encryption-at-rest confirmation.
Trial metrics to validate: token cost per 1M tokens, average p95 latency under 2000 concurrent chat sessions, and embedding recall on internal bench dataset.
Next demo: SE-led Dedicated sizing + canary rollout plan scheduled 2024-11-08 (calendar invite sent).
Action items from AE: get legal-approved EU residency clause, provide Dedicated sizing template, and run pricing scenarios for 50k/100k/200k ARR commitments.
